description: This Java source file defines the ShoppingCartEvents class which handles various HTTP event actions related to shopping cart operations in an e-commerce system built on the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for adding/removing products and promotions, updating cart items, handling checkout initialization, managing parties involved in an order, setting placeholders like order name and PO number, and other cart management functionalities.

classes.name: ShoppingCartEvents
classes.description: Provides static methods for handling HTTP events related to shopping cart operations such as adding/removing items, promotions, updating cart, initializing orders, and managing parties.

methods.name: addProductPromoCode
methods.description: Handles the event for adding a promo code to the shopping cart.

methods.name: removePromotion
methods.description: Handles the event to remove a promotion from the shopping cart.

methods.name: addItemGroup
methods.description: Creates a new item group within the shopping cart.

methods.name: addCartItemToGroup
methods.description: Associates an existing cart item with a specified item group.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds an item to the shopping cart, handling product details, configuration, rental info, promotions, and other parameters.

methods.name: addToCartFromOrder
methods.description: Adds items from a previous order into the current cart.

methods.name: addToCartBulk
methods.description: Adds multiple items from a category based on request parameters.

methods.name: quickInitPurchaseOrder
methods.description: Initializes a purchase order quickly, setting supplier, billing, and order details.

methods.name: quickCheckoutOrderWithDefaultOptions
methods.description: Sets default checkout options for quick order submission.

methods.name: addToCartBulkRequirements
methods.description: Adds requirements for multiple cart items in bulk.

methods.name: addCategoryDefaults
methods.description: Adds default products from a category according to the product's default quantity.

methods.name: deleteFromCart
methods.description: Removes an item from the shopping cart based on provided parameters.

methods.name: modifyCart
methods.description: Updates cart items, such as quantities or selections, based on request inputs.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Empties the entire shopping cart.

methods.name: destroyCart
methods.description: Wipes out the shopping cart data and removes it from the session.

methods.name: getCartObject
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the shopping cart object based on request, locale, and currency.

methods.name: switchCurrentCartObject
methods.description: Switches the current shopping cart in the session among multiple carts.

methods.name: clearCartFromList
methods.description: Removes a cart from the list of multiple carts in the session.

methods.name: keepCartUpdated
methods.description: Ensures the cart's user login info and locale are current.

methods.name: setDesiredAlternateGwpProductId
methods.description: Selects an alternative gift-with-purchase product for a promotional cart line.

methods.name: addAdditionalParty
methods.description: Associates an additional party with the order with a specific role.

methods.name: removeAdditionalParty
methods.description: Removes an associated party from the order.

methods.name: processResult
methods.description: Processes the result map from cart helper actions to format error messages and determine error severity.

methods.name: selectAgreement
methods.description: Associates an agreement with the cart/order.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the shopping cart.

methods.name: setOrderName
methods.description: Sets the order name of the cart.

methods.name: setPoNumber
methods.description: Sets the PO number of the cart.

methods.name: addOrderTerm
methods.description: Adds a term (e.g., payment, delivery) to the shopping cart/order.
